title: Ulyana and the Spire
author: Wendell Sandoval
blurb: Ada Montrose, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
